name: Passing Zhu Tong Technique (Combat,)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Constitution 17, Golden Bell Technique, Iron Shirt, BAB +11

Benefit(s): As a swift action a practitioner can expend 1 ki point to gain an additional 7 DR/- (total DR 10/-) from their Iron Shirt Style until the start of their next turn.
